notes.group_id: Rows that are alternate causes for the same symptom (e.g. the 3 alarm-402 causes) share a group_id. create_index.py groups the top hits by group_id so a multi-cause query returns every candidate in one response instead of just the single best-scoring row.
notes.distinguishing_condition: Only populated on rows that belong to a multi-cause group. Empty string for single-answer rows (cutting data, safety, single-cause alarms).
